measurement_scope: synthetic generator, this process, one stud

scene.name: s1b_bow_wall_3
scene.reference_meaning: This synthetic scene has a floor or slab. Lean is measured against the fitted floor normal. The cloud is not rotated. A SKIL or other level reading is not the reference.
scene.description: S1b synthetic wall, 3 2x4 studs. Stud slot 1 bows 6.35 mm at midspan along local Y. Ends held. Plates and floor are context. Not a stage-3 gate.
scene.chord_note: Stored long axis is the chord. Section error is not a bow amplitude.

implementation_short: Refined Open3D on an S1b probe. Oz_PC.

detection.note: Refined Open3D on this S1b probe. Counts are this synthetic scene, not a field accuracy.

geometry.note: Section is the two smaller minimal-OBB extents versus the dressed nominal. Length is the longest extent versus the generator length. Gaussian tails and the plate slab margin both move these numbers.

angle.band_meaning: Percent of matched studs whose |measured - synthetic truth| is within the working tolerance.
angle.note: Truth is the generator axis against the fitted floor normal. Synthetic tests measure lean against the fitted floor normal when the scene has a floor or slab, and against generator +Z only when it does not. They do not use a SKIL or any other level reading. The stored axis is the chord. A bow amplitude is not this angle.

paint.production_rule: epsilon unlocked, so every stud is yellow
paint.hypothetical_placeholder_note: 0.05 deg is a round illustration of the color rule. It is not a measured device band.
paint.note: Do not read hypothetical colors as a pass/fail call.

failure_modes: DBSCAN eps above the bay gap merges neighboring studs into one box.
DBSCAN eps below the surface spacing splits one stud into faces.
A plate side face left behind bridges bays.
Peeling a vertical stud-face plane would delete the wall.
PCA OBB on a short or one-sided cluster can yaw the long axis.
cost.note: Runtime is this process on this scene. It is not a field budget.

notes: Synthetic stage 0 only. Not a field measurement. Device epsilon is unlocked, so production paint is yellow.
rigid_bars_note: These are the rigid dressed-stud bars. A bow fattens the section. This list is not a bow-amplitude error and not a field acceptance test.
